title: Signed status receiver
summary: Reject credentials unless their issuer-signed status is active, correctly bound and fresh.
test_interface: Python adapter(case) -> bool; True means accepted; exceptions are test errors, not successful rejection.

requirements.text: Accept a correctly signed, bound and fresh active statement.
Reject a statement changed after signing.
Verify with receiver-configured keys, never a response-provided key.
Bind the status issuer to the credential issuer.
Bind the statement to the exact credential.
Bind the statement to the credential status reference.
Require the echoed requested ID to match the credential or status ID.
Reject statements issued in the future (strict-clock profile).
Reject validity windows longer than 60 seconds.

not_tested: Credential expiry and issuer accreditation chains
Dataset authorization, execution and release gates

example.compatibility: Providers may also accept credential and status_id; conflicting supplied identifiers must be rejected.

governance: Towns opt in. No authority or data permission follows from a test pass. Published profile documents are immutable; normative changes require a new version. Implementation-specific exceptions remain failures, with an explanation in the report.
